cohort: Women who underwent cesarean delivery at a single tertiary medical center between 2011 and 2019
finding: Multiple pregnancy, preterm delivery, Apgar score < 7, and non-elective cesarean delivery were identified as independent risk factors for prolonged hospitalization after cesarean delivery, while antenatal thrombocytopenia was found to be a protective factor.
mod_finding: Non-elective cesarean delivery was found to be an independent risk factor for prolonged hospitalization.
